focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 科研个人陈述（SoP / Research Narrative）：从时间序列/生成建模迈向具身智能的闭环叙事段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Past Core Thread -> Concrete Method & Metric -> Intellectual Bridge (Passive Forecasting -> Active Closed-Loop Control) -> Future Embodied AI Agenda. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L025, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 包含 SoP 两大禁忌：① 童年情怀套话（Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by...）；② 盲目追热点（because it is a very hot topic），没讲清你过去的时序/生成建模背景赋予了你做具身智能什么独特优势。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: My research focuses on learning reliable representations and generative trajectories from non-stationary sequential data. While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Related Work 批判分类与 Methodology 机制阐述（BP09–BP16）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 整体模型架构数据流俯瞰段（Framework Overview & Pipeline Walkthrough）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想配合论文里的 Figure 2（模型总架构图），用一段话把输入张量从左到右流经各个模块直到输出预测结果的完整全貌讲清楚。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Methodology 第 3.2 节 Architecture Overview
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [总图锚定与设计哲学 Visual Anchor & Philosophy]：Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of [Model], which processes [Input] through three sequential stages: [Stage 1], [Stage 2], and [Stage 3].
S2 [阶段 1 数据流 Stage 1 Flow]：Given raw input $\mathbf{X}$, the [Module 1] first transforms [Raw Input] into [Intermediate Representation $\mathbf{Z}^{(1)}$] to [Functional Purpose 1].
S3 [阶段 2 数据流 Stage 2 Flow]：Next, these [Summary Noun: representations $\mathbf{Z}^{(1)}$] are fed into [Module 2], which [Mechanism 2] to produce [Refined State $\mathbf{Z}^{(2)}$].
S4 [阶段 3 解码与闭环输出 Stage 3 Decoding]：Finally, the [Module 3] integrates $\mathbf{Z}^{(2)}$ with [Prior/Scale Cue] to output the final [Prediction/Action Trajectory].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: 严格的链式数据流（$\mathbf{X} \to \mathbf{Z}^{(1)} \to \mathbf{Z}^{(2)} \to \hat{\mathbf{Y}}$），每一句句首承接上一句的输出张量。绑定逻辑规则：L001, L003, L004.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Figure 2 shows our model. There is a Patch Encoder on the left. In the middle, there is a Spectral Block and a Graph Block. On the right, a Linear Decoder outputs the result.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 写成看图说话的静态空间方位描述（on the left, in the middle, on the right），没有体现张量变换的数据流动与功能因果。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DyTS-Net, which maps raw sensor streams to multi-horizon forecasts through three sequential stages. Given an input sequence $\mathbf{X}$, the Adaptive De-stationary Tokenizer first separates local trend-scale statistics from normalized sub-series patches $\mathbf{Z}_0$. These normalized patches then pass through stacked Spectral-Spatial Mixing blocks, which jointly filter high-frequency channel noise in the Fourier domain and propagate cross-sensor phase dependencies via a sparse directed graph. Finally, the Scale-Guided Decoder fuses the refined structural representations with the projected neural-ODE scale trajectory to reconstruct the multi-horizon output $\hat{\mathbf{Y}}$.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 图表小作文首段：题目改写与总体趋势概览（Paraphrase + Macro Overview）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Academic Task 1 首段（Introduction + Overview）或实验趋势总览段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [图表命题同义改写 Prompt Paraphrase]：The line graph / bar chart compares [Variable/Metric] across [Categories/Regions] over a [N]-year period from [Year A] to [Year B].
S2 [宏观趋势 1：总体走向与反超 Overview Trend 1]：Overall, while [Category A and B] experienced a steady upward trajectory, [Category C] declined markedly, leading to a reversal in dominance around [Mid-Year].
S3 [宏观趋势 2：极值或差距特征 Overview Trend 2]：Notably, [Category A] registered the most dramatic growth throughout the period, ultimately overtaking all other sectors to become the primary contributor.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Paraphrase -> Overall Trajectory Contrast -> Dominant Crossover/Extremum (Zero raw numbers in Overview!). 绑定逻辑规则：L013, L015.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The chart shows the energy consumption from 2000 to 2025. We can see that solar energy went up a lot from 5% to 35%, and coal went down from 60% to 25%. Wind also went up.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 词汇低幼（went up a lot, went down）；② 把具体百分比过早塞进了 Overview，导致后面细节段无话可写。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The line graph compares the proportion of electricity generated from four fuel sources across three industrial economies between 2000 and 2025. Overall, renewable sources—particularly solar and wind power—followed a pronounced upward trajectory over the 25-year span, whereas coal reliance contracted steadily. Most notably, clean energy generation overtook fossil-fuel consumption around 2018, shifting from a marginal supplement to the dominant power supply by the end of the period.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Spoken Rhythm, Visual Anchoring, and Rhetorical Signposting
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 听众无法像读论文那样倒回去重读长定语从句。把书面段转化为演讲稿时，必须：① 砍掉多重嵌套从句，拆为 10–15 词的清晰短句；② 先给视觉坐标（Look at the red curve in the upper-right panel）再讲结论；③ 用轻量设问（Why does this spike happen? Because...）引导注意力。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Visual Anchor: Turning to the right panel of Slide 4,] -> [Short Rhetorical Question: why does the baseline diverge after step 50?] -> [Crisp Causal Answer: The answer lies in compound orientation drift.]
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 拿着书面论文原封不动照念长达 40 个词的复合句，台下听众在前 10 秒就丢失了主谓关系。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: As illustrated in Figure 4, the trajectory generated by the baseline model without temporal consistency regularization exhibits substantial oscillation around the target waypoint.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Take a look at the dashed blue trajectory in Figure 4. Notice how violently the robot arm oscillates near the target waypoint. Why does this happen? Without temporal consistency regularization, adjacent action chunks conflict with one another.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Take a look at... -> Notice how... -> Why does this happen? -> Without X, Y conflicts... 营造极具现场掌控力的母语级 Tech Talk 节奏。

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (生成模型专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Fidelity, Mode Coverage, and Sampling Efficiency Trilemma
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 分析生成模型（Diffusion, Flow Matching, Autoregressive, GAN, VAE）时，段落逻辑应围绕生成三难困境（Trilemma）展开：① 样本保真度（Sample Fidelity / Temporal Realism）、② 分布模式覆盖度/多样性（Mode Coverage / Diversity，防止 Mode Collapse）、③ 推理采样步数与速度（Inference NFE / Sampling Latency）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: While [Model Family A] excels at [Fidelity/Diversity], it incurs [High NFE / Mode Collapse]. -> By reformulating the generation trajectory via [Rectified Flow / Consistency Distillation], our approach preserves [Property 1] while reducing sampling steps from [N] to [k].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只说 the generated samples look very good and realistic，缺乏分布覆盖度与采样效率维度的严谨坐标。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Diffusion models generate very realistic data, but they are too slow. Our model makes them fast and still good.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While denoising diffusion models capture multi-modal trajectory distributions without mode collapse, their reliance on tens of iterative solver steps precludes real-time control. By straightening the probability flow ODE via reflow distillation, our generator preserves multi-modal path diversity while compressing inference to a single forward pass.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 精准使用 multi-modal trajectory distributions、without mode collapse、iterative solver steps、straightening the probability flow ODE 等领域高阶表达。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L018 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 包含 SoP 两大禁忌：① 童年情怀套话（Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by...）；② 盲目追热点（because it is a very hot topic），没讲清你过去的时序/生成建模背景赋予了你做具身智能什么独特优势。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。

While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Recovering missing sensor observations is essential for reliable downstream monitoring in industrial and clinical time series. While diffusion-based imputation models generate plausible trajectories under random missingness, they suffer from high sampling latency and lose global periodic coherence when entire sensor blocks drop out consecutively. We present FlowImp, a conditional flow-matching framework that reconstructs contiguous missing blocks in three ODE solver steps. Specifically, FlowImp anchors straight transport paths on observed spectral priors and enforces cross-channel phase consistency via a lightweight Fourier regularizer. Across six multivariate benchmarks under 50% block missingness, FlowImp reduces imputation MAE by 19.3% compared with CSDI while accelerating inference by 24x.
